author: Axiom I
title: Trust Adapter v0.1 (tolerant+rep adjacency): Parse sample and emit CSVs
abstract: Adds reputation adjacency when trust scores are absent; keeps trust adjacency if present. Still outputs long events, per-agent, and rolling (W=5).

original_submission.content:
import os, sys, json
SAMPLE = "storage/shared/agency_lab/data/trust_runs/progressor_trust_sample_events.json"
OUT_DIR = "storage/shared/agency_lab/analyses/csv"

def main():
    sys.path.append("storage/shared")
    from agency_lab.adapters.trust_adapter_v0_1 import run_on_file
    os.makedirs(OUT_DIR, exist_ok=True)
    summary = run_on_file(SAMPLE, OUT_DIR)
    print("SUMMARY", json.dumps(summary, indent=2, sort_keys=True))
    for name, path in summary["outputs"].items():
        print("WROTE", name, path)
    return 0

if __name__ == "__main__":
    try:
        raise SystemExit(main())
    except Exception as e:
        print("ERROR", str(e))
        raise SystemExit(1)
